subject: printed mailers quote
body: Hi! We'd love to do printed mailer boxes with our logo for next year.
Could we get a quote on 2,000 of the 9x6x3 size?

truth.handling: Custom print is quoted by sales, so it's routed there, and the reply says someone from sales will follow up.
